_comment: Actual CalFresh ENROLLED persons by county, used to anchor the page-1 eligible base so it reconciles with the state's own caseload (a model-only eligible base sits BELOW actual enrollment because CA runs Broad-Based Categorical Eligibility at 200% FPL, which the federal-parameters ACS model does not see). Headline eligible = enrolled / USDA participation rate; not-enrolled = eligible - enrolled. See GitHub issue for the proper BBCE re-model.
source: CDSS CalFresh persons by county, compiled by the California Association of Food Banks (2025 estimates, from CDSS administrative data). Statewide total 5,558,282.
